# Задача: анализ LLDB-сессии

Найди сравниваемый ключ.

(lldb) breakpoint set -n -[LicenseManager validate:]
Breakpoint 1 at 0x100004a20
(lldb) register read x1
      x1 = 0x283a1c240
(lldb) memory read --format c --count 24 0x283a1c240
0x283a1c240: PREMIUM-UNLOCK-KEY-2024  # flag: nto{lldb_r3g1st3r_l34k}
